last_episode_to_air.name: World Championship Wrestling - Jul. 08, 1989
last_episode_to_air.overview: Terry Funk joins Paul E. Dangerously on The Danger Zone. Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat issues a challenge to Lex Luger for the United States Championship. Plus, The Steiner Brothers, Flyin' Brian Pillman, The Fabulous Freebirds, and many more in action.
